estimates.assumptions: 1 whole medium chicken (~1.2 kg raw with skin and bone); meat has no carbs
2 cups uncooked basmati rice (360 g dry weight); standard 80 g carbs / 1.7 g fiber per 100 g dry
1 large onion (~150 g raw, peeled); ~9 g carbs and 2 g fiber per 100 g
4 cloves garlic (~12 g raw); ~33 g carbs and 2.1 g fiber per 100 g
2 green chillies (~20 g raw); ~9 g carbs and 1.7 g fiber per 100 g
3 tbsp neutral oil (42 g); pure fat has no carbs
1 tbsp turmeric powder (~7 g); ~70 g carbs and 23 g fiber per 100 g
1 tsp ground coriander (~2 g); ~55 g carbs and 35 g fiber per 100 g (rounded)
0.5 tbsp cardamom pods (~4 g whole); ~50 g carbs and 40 g fiber per 100 g (rounded)
0.25 tsp whole cloves (~1 g); ~60 g carbs and 30 g fiber per 100 g (rounded)
0.5 tsp ground cinnamon (~1.5 g); ~80 g carbs and 53 g fiber per 100 g (rounded)
1 tsp ground pepper (~2 g); ~64 g carbs and 33 g fiber per 100 g (rounded)
2 bay leaves (~1 g dry); ~75 g carbs and 40 g fiber per 100 g (rounded)
